# Muskan Choudhary — Data Analyst Portfolio

> Muskan Choudhary is a data analyst and final-year B.Tech Computer Science student at Jagannath University, Jaipur (CGPA 7.5/10). Core stack: SQL, Power BI, Microsoft Excel and Python. Based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, originally from Darbhanga, Bihar. Open to entry-level Data Analyst, Reporting Analyst and Business Intelligence Graduate roles.

This site is the personal portfolio of Muskan Choudhary. It documents four end-to-end data analysis case studies. All content is statically rendered server-side: no JavaScript is required to read any page. Contact: muskanchy05@gmail.com

## Skills

- Analysis and visualisation: Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP, VLOOKUP, Data Validation), Power BI, interactive dashboards, slicers, data reporting
- Databases: SQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL), JOINs, GROUP BY, subqueries, aggregations, conditional filtering
- Programming: Python (pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib), Jupyter
- Analytical: data cleaning, data accuracy, ad-hoc analysis, trend analysis, KPI tracking, statistics and probability

## Case studies

- [COVID-19 Pandemic Analysis](https://muskan-portfolio.vercel.app/projects/covid19-pandemic-analysis): a reproducible Python pipeline producing 13 processed datasets for 200+ countries; strongest socioeconomic signal was rural population share vs cases per million (r = −0.46). Repository: https://github.com/Heyymuskie/covid19-pandemic-analysis
- [Cracow Property Price Model](https://muskan-portfolio.vercel.app/projects/cracow-property-price-model): web-scraped flat listings cleaned with KNN imputation, eight engineered ratio features, five-fold GridSearchCV, and a VotingRegressor beating MLP and gradient boosting on RMSE, MAE and MSLE. Repository: https://github.com/Heyymuskie/cracow-property-price-model
- [FX Trading Performance Analysis](https://muskan-portfolio.vercel.app/projects/fx-trading-performance-analysis): 92 broker trades analysed for skew, kurtosis, drawdown and loss runs, with a 100,000-run Monte Carlo estimate of forward expectancy; win rate approximately 40%. Repository: https://github.com/Heyymuskie/fx-trading-performance-analysis
- [Fitness Workload Regression](https://muskan-portfolio.vercel.app/projects/fitness-workload-regression): 283 Polar watch workouts flattened from nested JSON; OLS versus a linear mixed model cut calorie-prediction RMSE from 79 to 61, with duration/calories correlation of 0.92. Repository: https://github.com/Heyymuskie/fitness-workload-regression
